text: In contemporary astronomy, explain why Earth orbits the Sun.
Using the diction of an early natural philosopher, describe the claim that Earth journeys around the Sun.
In clear modern language, explain the geocentric claim that the heavens revolve around Earth.
In premodern scholarly style, set forth the doctrine that Earth rests at the center while the celestial spheres turn.
Give a concise scientific account of the Sun-centered arrangement of the solar system.
In antique phrasing, present the Sun as the lamp about which Earth makes its circuit.
Describe, as a historical cosmology, the Earth-centered ordering of planets and fixed stars.
With scholastic wording, explain how the wandering stars may be carried in circles about the unmoved Earth.
